blocks.text: Protect hard floors and stabilize heavy furniture with SoftTouch Square Reusable Carpet Bottom Furniture Caster Cups. Designed to sit securely under furniture legs and casters, these office chair caster cups help prevent scratches, dents, and pressure marks on hardwood, tile, laminate, and vinyl flooring. The integrated carpeted bottom allows furniture to glide smoothly when repositioning while reducing friction and minimizing noise, making them ideal for sofas, pianos, office chairs, cabinets, and other heavy pieces. A cupped design keeps casters and legs centered and contained, helping furniture stay in place during everyday use while still allowing controlled movement when needed. Made from durable metal with soft carpet padding, these reusable furniture caster cups provide dependable floor protection without adhesives or permanent installation. Easy to use and discreet in appearance, they blend seamlessly into home or office environments while extending the life of both floors and furniture.
